text:
ajay: Heads up — starting ~03:02 UTC we saw sustained 429s from the embeddings endpoint in us-west-2, but only for requests that hit the rerank-capacity lane.
cheng: Noticed that too. Dashboard shows embed lane saturated, but rerank lane spiky CPU on a subset of pods. Could be cold-KV churn + batching backlog.
ops-bot: Incident alert: rerank-lane queue depth > 250 for 4m, autoscale triggered 2x.
sarah: Can someone paste the pod logs for the busiest replica? I want to see whether we’re seeing KV cache misses or network egress timeouts.
leo: quick paste from the busiest pod logs:
```
[03:04:12] WARN kv_cache: miss=184, hit=32, evict=58
[03:04:12] INFO batcher: in_flight=48, avg_latency_ms=310
[03:04:13] ERROR rerank_worker: downstream_timeout to indexer 500ms
```
maria: That matches: high miss rate -> more compute per request -> longer service times -> queueing at the admission controller. We should be throttling earlier.
ajay: Current admission policy is a fixed per-lane concurrency limit + soft-limit queue of 200. When queue > 150 we send 429 with Retry-After. But that doesn't account for variable p99 service times when KV misses spike.
cheng: Proposal: switch rerank lane to fairshare with burst credits and introduce a dynamic concurrency cap based on measured p95 service time. Rough sketch config:
```
admission:
  type: fairshare
  lanes: [embed, rerank]
  rerank:
    base_concurrency: 24
    burst_credits: 8
    dynamic_window: 60s
    p95_threshold_ms: 220
```
leo: We also could return an informative header so apps can degrade gracefully: `X-RW-Queue: lane=rerank;pos=87;est_wait_ms=420`. That helped some customers during last surge.
sarah: Agree on headers. Also recommend a small grace-policy: allow small single-call retries for internal clients (2 retries with jitter) but block client-side retries for public API keys to avoid thundering.
maria: Cost note: using burst credits aggressively increases GPU minutes. If we enable burst for rerank, we should gate it by customer tier or add a cost-flag so sales can opt-in.
ajay: Action items:
- (cheng) put the fairshare config behind a feature flag and simulate with canary 10% traffic to rerank-lane (due in 2h)
- (leo) add X-RW-Queue header to gateway 1h change
- (sarah) add a small escalation doc for SRE playbook about KV cache warming and forced drains
- (maria) model cost impact of burst credits by EOW

cheng: Starting the canary in 5m. Will watch p95/p99 and queue depths, and post quick results.
ops-bot: Canary job started: canary-id=c-20260301-11, target=10% of rerank traffic.
ajay: Thanks — post any anomalies here. If we see tail latency > 400ms we rollback the canary immediately.
